title: Synergistic impact of rice husk biomass derived carbon supports on the performance of biogenic Fe0-catalyzed advanced oxidation processes for oxytetracycline remediation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00912F, Paper
Sandeep Kumar, Parminder Kaur, Jyoti Rani, Janpreet Singh, Sandeep Kaushal, J. Nagendra Babu, Sunil Mittal
This study investigates rice husk biomass and its derived carbon materials—hydrochar and biochar—as supports for biogenic zerovalent iron nanocomposites (ZVI@RH, ZVI@HC, and ZVI@BC) in advanced oxidation processes (AOPs) to degrade oxytetracycline.
